import sys,json,os
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);used=0
for directory,dirs,files in os.walk(r,followlinks=False):
 if Path(directory)==r/'mount':dirs[:]=[]
 used+=Path(directory).stat().st_blocks*512+sum((Path(directory)/x).stat().st_blocks*512 for x in files)
print(json.dumps({'owned_allocated_bytes_excluding_fuse_mounts':used}))
